chunks: From him, from Al-Washsha, from Muhammad ibn Fudayl al-Sayrafi, from Al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, the kinship of the Progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon them), the Imams (peace be upon them), is suspended from the Throne, saying: 'O Allah! Maintain relationship with the one who maintains relationship with me, and cut off the one who cuts me off.'
Then it flows, after that, in the kinship of the believers.
And fear Allah, by whom you ask one another, and the kinship.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual status of the Imams' kinship according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) highlights the metaphysical status of the Ahl al-Bayt's kinship, personified as a supplicant hanging from the Divine Throne, which underscores the spiritual weight of maintaining ties with the Imams. The narration then extends this divine favor to the broader community, linking the specific reverence for the Imams to the general obligation of silat al-rahim among all believers. This connection is firmly rooted in the recitation of Surah An-Nisa, verse 1, which couples the fear of Allah with the maintenance of kinship ties.
